description: Server-to-server pixel track and batch requests to the TikTok Events API on business-api.tiktok.com.

params.name: pixel_code
params.description: It is the Pixel ID from Events Manager. TikTok documents it as required on both the single-event track call and the batch call.
params.fix_hint: Set `pixel_code` to the Pixel ID shown in Events Manager.

params.name: batch
params.description: The batch endpoint posts events under `batch`. The track endpoint posts a single event at the root instead.

params.name: event
params.description: It is the conversion event name. TikTok documents it as required on every track payload.
params.fix_hint: Set `event` to a documented web event name, such as `CompletePayment` or `ViewContent`.

params.name: event_id
params.description: It identifies the event for deduplication against the browser pixel. TikTok documents it as required when the same conversion is sent from both.
params.fix_hint: Send the same `event_id` the Pixel fired, so the pair collapses to one conversion.

params.name: timestamp
params.description: TikTok documents the event time as an ISO 8601 timestamp. An epoch number is not that format, and TikTok then stamps the event with the time it arrived.
params.fix_hint: Send an ISO 8601 timestamp, such as `2026-07-26T06:00:00Z`.

params.name: context.ip
params.description: It is the visitor's public IP address, sent unhashed.
params.fix_hint: Send the browser's public IP, not a SHA-256 digest and not your server's address.

params.name: context.user_agent
params.description: It is the visitor's user agent, sent unhashed.
params.fix_hint: Send the browser's user agent string, not a digest.

params.name: context.user.email
params.description: Email must be SHA-256 hashed on the client side before it is sent.
params.fix_hint: Trim and lowercase the address, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

params.name: context.user.phone_number
params.description: Phone must be SHA-256 hashed on the client side before it is sent.
params.fix_hint: Normalize the number, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

params.name: context.user.external_id
params.description: Advertiser-side identifiers must be SHA-256 hashed on the client side.
params.fix_hint: Hash the identifier with SHA-256 and send the hex digest.

params.name: properties.currency
params.description: It is an ISO 4217 currency code.
params.fix_hint: Use the three-letter code, such as `USD`.

params.name: properties.value
params.description: It is the total value of the order or items, not the unit price.

rules.message: A field carries what looks like a raw email address. TikTok requires customer email to be SHA-256 hashed on the client side.
rules.fix_hint: Trim the address, lowercase it, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

rules.message: This field looks like a SHA-256 digest, but TikTok documents `context.ip` and `context.user_agent` as unhashed.
rules.fix_hint: Send the raw IP address or user agent. Hashing it makes the event unmatchable.
